title: Activation Functions — A Gate Between Layers
key_insight: An activation function bends each layer’s numbers before passing them on. That bend lets later layers combine signals into curved and detailed rules.
body:
## A Gate Between Layers

Two layers keep making only straight boundaries, no matter how many times they are stacked. The model cannot wrap around a curved pattern.

An activation function bends each layer’s numbers before passing them on. That bend lets later layers combine signals into curved and detailed rules.

ReLU keeps positive values and turns negative values into zero. It is a common hidden-layer gate because it is simple and usually trains well.
common_mistakes: Activations permanently remove the need for weights.
Every activation produces text labels directly.
The same output gate is correct for every possible task.

real_world_usage: The activation choice changes signal flow, output meaning, and how easily a network trains.
